2026_04_DET_CAR.headline: Detroit’s improving defense targets a Carolina offense searching for balance up front
2026_04_DET_CAR.paragraph1: Detroit comes off a Week 3 win in which Dan Campbell praised a markedly improved defensive performance, an encouraging sign for a team that can already stress opponents offensively. Carolina is trying to repair a run game that has struggled through three weeks, and Bryce Young is expected to play while being evaluated for a lower-body issue. With Jaycee Horn also headed for an extended absence, Carolina needs cleaner line play and sustained drives to keep Detroit from dictating the game on both sides.
2026_04_DET_CAR.model_rationale: Detroit can press its advantage if its defensive improvement holds, while Carolina needs better rushing efficiency and healthy quarterback movement to avoid exposing a depleted defense to repeated possessions.
